## Findings for review

Paste your research or AI result here. A single useful source or correction is welcome. Distinguish what the source says from interpretations, and leave missing facts unknown.

## Original sources

For each source, include as much of this as you can verify:

## Submission status

This is an **unreviewed draft**. Submitting it does not change a county's map color. Maintainers will check the evidence and decide what to publish; review timing is not guaranteed.
